z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Since f(x) = (x−2)² − 1, lowest value −1 happen at x = 2, and values rise again for x > 2. So for every k at least 2, minimum remain −1. If you first choose a, point out which table change your prediction.

z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.info: For k = 4 (0 ≤ x ≤ 4): at x = 0, f = 3, and at x = 4, f = 3, so both endpoints get same value. Maximum na 3. When we widen to k = 5, f = 8 at x = 5 become new maximum.

z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.after: For 0 ≤ k ≤ 4, f(k) ≤ 3, so maximum na f(0)=3; for k > 4, f(k) pass 3. Seoyeon prediction correct only when k < 2 for minimum, and only when k > 4 for maximum. The range wey e correct split according to condition (interval).

z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: You no check say maximum remain 3 when k = 3 and k = 4. Compare whether newly added x values give more than existing maximum.

z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: You miss say f(5)=8 show at k = 5. Check whether endpoint value continue growing.

z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: This judgment compare which endpoint, x = 0 or x = k, get bigger value.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.reflect: Some people first predict “minimum dey continue getting smaller” and change their mind after table past x = 2; others predict “e fit stop” and keep am. For one line, say which table change (or keep) your judgment.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.prompt: For domain 0 ≤ x ≤ k, choose k wey make (maximum) − (minimum) = 4. (k positive real number.)

z-m-38-04.title: If both formulas fit all 3 records, which one make we trust?
z-m-38-04.topic: Choosing formula wey fit data (comparing inverse proportion and quadratic function)
z-m-38-04.goal: Compare two formula types wey pass through the same 3 data points. Use new measurement and how situation work to choose which one and how much to trust, and state the range you trust am for.
z-m-38-04.material: Dem pour 12 L water equally into x same-size bottles (x positive integer), and measure amount y (L) in one bottle. Records: 1 bottle, 12 L; 2 bottles, 6 L; 3 bottles, 4 L. Two friends give formulas. Jiwon: y = 12/x (read as: 12 divided by x). Hyunwoo: y = 2x² − 12x + 22 (read as: 2 x squared minus 12x plus 22). Water no leak and dem share am equally among bottles.
z-m-38-04.thinking.0: Calculate yourself to check if data and model agree
z-m-38-04.thinking.1: Changing how much you trust something as new evidence show up
z-m-38-04.thinking.2: Separating what fit the data from what fit the situation
z-m-38-04.prereq.1: Finding function values (substituting x inside formula and calculating)
z-m-38-04.prereq.2: Reading formulas for quadratic function and rational function y=k/x
z-m-38-04.prereq.3: The relationship: (number of bottles) × (amount in one bottle) = total amount
z-m-38-04.s.s1.prompt: Looking only at these 3 records, choose the most suitable statement.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.0: Put x = 1, 2, 3 into each of the two formulas and compare with the records in a table.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.1: Think whether formula wey pass through 3 points na the only one, or if more than one fit exist.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.a: y=12/x simpler, so these records alone show say Jiwon formula correct.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.a: You use “the formula simple” like proof. Simplicity fit be reason to believe, but data no prove am.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.b: y=2x²−12x+22 get only integer coefficients, so e more accurate and Hyunwoo formula correct.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.b: You judge accuracy from how coefficients look. You only know if formula fit data by putting values inside.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.c: Both formulas fit the 3 records, so the records alone no show which one correct.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.c: This judgment understand say when two formulas fit same data, data alone no fit tell them apart.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.d: Formula through three points unique, so one of the two gats get calculation error.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.d: You think formula through three points must be unique. Even if quadratic function pass through 3 points, another kind formula fit pass same points too.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.explain: Substituting x = 1, 2, 3 gives 12, 6, 4 for both formulas, which matches the records. Since two formulas fit the same data, the records alone cannot tell them apart. To decide which formula to trust, you need other grounds, like a new measurement or the structure of the situation.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.prompt: New information go show one part at a time. At each step, decide how your trust in the two formulas change.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.0: Put the revealed number of bottles x into both formulas to find the predicted values yourself, and compare them with the measured value.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.1: When measured value differ from prediction, think about both: formula fit wrong, or measurement fit wrong.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.info: We share water among 4 bottles and measure amount in one: e be 3 L.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.ask: When you compare this measurement with predictions from both formulas, wetin you conclude about them?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.after: Jiwon formula predict 3 L when x = 4, and Hyunwoo predict 6 L. Measured 3 L match Jiwon formula and differ plenty from Hyunwoo. E make sense to trust Jiwon now, or measure again because measurement fit get error.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.o.a: Measurement fit wrong, so measure one more time before you decide.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.a: This careful attitude no jump to conclusion with one measurement; e wan check again.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.b: This judgment trust more the formula whose prediction near the measured value.

z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.info: With 6 bottles, measured 2 L; with 12 bottles, measured 1 L. (Now na 5 records.)
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.ask: How you fit state your trust in Jiwon formula y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.after: As more data come, you trust Jiwon formula more. But 5 records alone no guarantee all x values. If you get reason from how situation work, your trust fit stronger.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.a: All 5 records correct, so we fit conclude formula correct for every positive integer x.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.a: You take “records correct five times” and apply am to everything. Dem never check x values wey dem no measure.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.b: Even if more records match, our trust no change at all.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.b: This no consider that new measurement support the same direction too.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.c: We trust am more because 5 records fit, but we still need another reason to say e work for x values wey we no measure.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.c: This judgment say evidence increase trust, but you need reason before applying am to all cases.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.info: If you multiply number of bottles by amount for one bottle, you always get total 12 L. Water no leak and dem share am equally.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.ask: Since we know that, wetin we fit say about Jiwon formula y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.after: Because x·y = 12, y = 12/x come directly from the situation, no be from records alone. So under the assumption “water no leak and dem share am equally,” we fit say e work for every positive integer x. If assumption no hold (water leak), formula too change.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.a: No be only the records; because of how situation work, y=12/x hold for every positive integer x as long as water no leak and dem share am equally.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.a: This judgment set trust level using both reasons: evidence from data and how situation work.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.b: We still need depend only on 5 records; how situation work no be proof.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.b: You miss that relationship from the situation (constant product) directly determine the formula.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Hyunwoo formula happen to pass through the three points, so Jiwon formula wrong.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Hyunwoo formula passing through three points no mean Jiwon formula wrong. His formula no match how situation work for other x values.
